name: Laravel 12 Code Quality Assurance
description: Comprehensive code quality checks and Laravel 12 best practices enforcement

steps.content:
🔍 Laravel 12 Code Quality Check:

✅ PHP 8.3+ features used
✅ Constructor property promotion
✅ Explicit return type declarations

✅ Laravel 12 conventions followed
✅ Eloquent relationships typed
✅ N+1 queries prevented
✅ PHPDoc blocks added
✅ Descriptive naming used
